state.summary: Stock badge shows 'In stock' for sold-out products
state.description: On the product page the badge ignores reservations and shows 'In stock' when every unit is reserved.
acceptance_criteria: A product with 0 available units shows 'Sold out'

area.instructions: Which product area of the application does this ticket primarily change? Choose the single area whose description best matches where the requested change lives.

criteria.account: Sign-up, login, profile and order history.
criteria.catalog: Product listing, search, product detail pages and stock display.
criteria.checkout: Cart, payment form, order placement and confirmation.

kind.instructions: What kind of change does this ticket ask for?

criteria.bugfix: Fixes behavior that is wrong today, without adding new capabilities.
criteria.minor_feature: Adds a small, self-contained capability or option to an existing flow.
criteria.refactor: Restructures code without changing user-visible behavior.
criteria.architecture: Changes system structure: new services, data models, cross-cutting infrastructure, or how components communicate.

risk.instructions: How risky is it to implement this ticket incorrectly, for users and for the business?
criteria: Trivial: copy, styling or configuration with no behavioral impact.
Low: a localized behavior change in one module, easy to verify and revert.
Medium: a behavior change across several modules, or one that touches persisted data.
High: changes a critical flow (payments, authentication, orders) or data shared by many features.
Critical: could cause data loss, a security exposure or a full outage if wrong.

clear_e2e_criteria.instructions: The ticket states acceptance criteria concrete enough that an end-to-end browser test can verify each of them through observable outcomes.

criteria.true: Every criterion names an observable result in the UI or the API that a test can assert.
criteria.false: Criteria are missing, vague, or only describe implementation details.

touches_money_or_security.instructions: Implementing this ticket changes how money is charged, refunded or displayed, or changes authentication, authorization, secrets or the handling of personal data.

criteria.true: The change affects payments, prices, refunds, login, permissions, tokens, secrets or personal data.
criteria.false: The change does not touch money, access control, secrets or personal data.

agent_suitable.instructions: A competent autonomous coding agent could implement this ticket correctly using only the ticket text and the repository, without asking a human any clarifying question.

criteria.true: The goal, scope and expected behavior are unambiguous and self-contained.
criteria.false: The ticket needs product decisions, design input, access to external systems or clarification.

changes_existing_flow.instructions: This ticket intentionally changes how an existing user-facing process works (its steps, rules or outcome), rather than fixing it or adding a separate new process.

criteria.true: An existing process will behave differently on purpose after this change.
criteria.false: Existing processes keep working as they do today; the ticket fixes a defect or adds something new alongside them.
